{{Top|leg}}
A '''shield disruptor''' was a piece of technology that could disrupt the shields of enemy targets. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], some [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could equip shield disruptors, and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] made use of remote shield disruptors.
